summary: # Fuzzing with AFL++ The following describes how to fuzz with a target if source code is available. If you have a binary-only target, go to [fuzzing_binary-only_targets.md](fuzzing_binary-only_targets.md). Fuzzing source code is a three-step process: 1. Compile the target with a special compiler that prepares the target to be fuzzed efficiently. This step is called "instrumenting a target". 2. Prepare the fuzzing by selecting and optimizing the input corpus for the target. 3. Perform the fuzzing of the target by randomly mutating input and assessing if
